name: value-utilities/shadow-no-color
description: Custom box-shadow values with NO embedded color literal. Tailwind always appends `var(--tw-shadow-color)` to the --tw-shadow-colored variant so that a sibling `shadow-<color>` utility can override it. Exercises the path where formatBoxShadowValue adds a new color field rather than replacing an existing one. Regression from horizon-tailwind-react audit.
